subject.title: feat(ui): preview GitHub issues and pull requests on hover

question: Is the Gateway-owned public GitHub preview fetch surface acceptable with its current token, redirect, timeout, byte-limit, avatar, cache, and public-repository checks?
rationale: The implementation is code-reviewed and visually proven, but it adds a server-side network method that may use ambient host credentials, so maintainer intent is needed before treating that boundary as accepted.

options.title: Accept bounded Gateway fetcher
options.body: Proceed after changelog cleanup and conflict refresh if maintainers are satisfied that the public-only metadata and avatar-fetch checks are the intended boundary.

options.title: Require narrower boundary
options.body: Ask the branch to avoid ambient token use, reduce returned metadata, or add stricter tests before accepting the Gateway method.

options.title: Defer the preview API
options.body: Keep normal link navigation until a maintainer sponsors a different preview API or plugin-owned surface.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded Gateway fetcher
recommendation.body: Proceed after changelog cleanup and conflict refresh if maintainers are satisfied that the public-only metadata and avatar-fetch checks are the intended boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the live PR and linked feature request and is the clearest routing candidate for deciding whether this Gateway/UI surface should proceed.
